verdict.rationale: dlt supports write dispositions like 'full load' that replace/overwrite destination data and merge/upsert with deduplication, giving some control over what data persists at the destination, but there is no documented feature for record-level deletion, retention TTLs, PII purging, or deletion of pipeline metadata/logs in a hosted dltHub workspace. missing for 10: explicit retention-policy controls, delete/purge APIs, PII/field-level redaction, and any documentation of how dltHub-hosted logs/audit trails can be deleted or retention-limited.
